Name: EQUIP_PARAM_GENERATOR_ST
Description: Determines the parameters of generator parts.

Fields.Name: Disable Param: Network Test Version
Fields.Description: Exclude from the NT version or mark the ones to be excluded.

Fields.Name: Disable Param: Release Version
Fields.Description: Exclude from the product version or mark the items to be excluded.

Fields.Name: Model ID
Fields.Description: Model ID shown in the assembly detail view. Also determines the menu preview icon.

Fields.Name: Sort ID
Fields.Description: Order of this part in menus. Keep it to 7 digits at most: the game adds the upgrade level on top.

Fields.Name: Weight
Fields.Description: Weight of this part. In kg.

Fields.Name: Energy Output
Fields.Description: EN recovered per second in normal use.

Fields.Name: Energy Consumption
Fields.Description: EN consumed per second in normal use.

Fields.Name: Energy Output Delay
Fields.Description: Delay before EN starts recovering. In seconds.

Fields.Name: Energy Output Delay (when Empty)
Fields.Description: Delay before EN starts recovering when EN has run out. In seconds.

Fields.Name: Emergency EN Recovery
Fields.Description: EN recovered in an emergency, when EN has run out. In EN points. Likely the in-game post-recovery EN supply.

Fields.Name: Energy Firearm Specialization
Fields.Description: Energy weapon specialization of this generator.

Fields.Name: Manufacturer
Fields.Description: Manufacturer of this part. Also selects the corporation logo shown for it.

Fields.Name: Sale Value
Fields.Description: Price the part is bought for in the shop.

Fields.Name: Additional Particles: Direct Hit
Fields.Description: Defence material used to pick the additional particle effect when this part takes a critical hit.

Fields.Name: Thruster Particle Color Type
Fields.Description: Thruster particle effect replacement type. Coral also affects the core expansion particle effects.

Fields.Name: Inherited Generator ID
Fields.Description: If set, this row uses the data of the referenced generator row instead.
